description: This file defines an abstract PHP class SugarSoapService for implementing a SOAP web service in the SuiteCRM project. It outlines required methods for registering functions and types, managing SOAP properties, and setting observers, serving as a base class for SOAP service implementations.

classes.name: SugarSoapService
classes.description: An abstract class for creating SOAP web services within SuiteCRM, providing configuration and registration mechanisms for SOAP functions and types, and managing SOAP-related properties.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Abstract method to register functions to be exposed as web services.

methods.name: registerType
methods.description: Abstract method to register complex or simple types for SOAP serialization.

methods.name: setObservers
methods.description: Sets the SOAP server object on all registered observers.

methods.name: getSoapVersion
methods.description: Returns the SOAP version used, default is '1.1'.

methods.name: getNameSpace
methods.description: Returns the namespace URI for the SOAP service.

methods.name: getRegisteredImplClass
methods.description: Returns the name of the implementation class registered for the SOAP service.

methods.name: getRegisteredClass
methods.description: Returns the registry class associated with the SOAP service.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns the server object handling the SOAP request.
